title: claude-review: content-driven zero-turn no-op (policy-prose diffs) → step-B fail-closed red (non-blocking noise, zero Claude signal)
body:
## Summary

Post-restore (#266), the `claude-review` metadata-only lens **non-deterministically zero-turn no-ops as a function of injected-diff content**, leaving its tracking comment at the action's harness placeholder and driving the #146/#217 step-B completion-assertion **fail-closed red**. This is distinct from #266 (which was a *deterministic* no-op because the lens could not read the diff at all — fixed by diff injection, and demonstrably working: #270 reviewed cleanly). Here the lens *can* read the diff, reviews some PRs correctly, and no-ops on others; the driver correlates with **the injected diff containing the lens's own governing policy prose** (AGENTS.md merge-policy / Codex-verdict machinery), not `.github/**` workflow edits.

Non-required, non-blocking — but persistent red-X noise and **zero automated Claude review signal** on an important class of factory PRs (anything touching AGENTS.md, the Codex-verdict logic, or factory policy prose).

## Reproduction (three runs, one day, 14 Aug 2026)

| PR | head | run / job | diff content | `num_turns` | tool invocations | tracking-comment tail | step-B |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| #270 (control, PASS) | `2fe991ef` | job 94583862154 | `scripts/factory` + `tests/factory` only (pure code+test) | **4** | **3** | `REVIEW-COMPLETE: … (#183)` | ✅ green |
| #273 (FAIL a) | `3da6ccb` | run 31779133018 / job 94700863905 | **AGENTS.md** + `scripts/factory` + `tests/factory` | **1** | **0** | `I'll analyze this and get back to you.` | ❌ red |
| #273 (FAIL b) | `b8a95386` | run 31779889970 / job 94703161858 | **AGENTS.md** + `docs/factory-runbook.md` + `scripts/factory` + `tests/factory` | **1** | **0** | `I'll analyze this and get back to you.` | ❌ red |

Failing step (`Assert the review actually completed`), identical text on both #273 jobs:

```
::error::this run's tracking comment has no tracking checklist and its final line is not the terminal completion sentinel, so review completion cannot be proved (issues #146, #183)
```

In all three runs the SDK tool-catalog closure held: `CATALOG_METADATA_ONLY=true`, `RESULT_CLEAN=true`, `changeset_empty=false` (non-empty diff injected). The only field that differs is **model behaviour**.

## Exact fail condition

`.github/workflows/claude-code-review.yml`, step "Assert the review actually completed":

1. The #217-tightened **metadata-only early-accept** (≈L1068–1075) accepts only when `CATALOG_METADATA_ONLY=true` **AND** `RESULT_CLEAN=true` **AND** `LAST_LINE == SENTINEL` (the #183 `REVIEW-COMPLETE …` terminal sentinel as the final non-empty line). On #273 the first two conjuncts held but `LAST_LINE` was the harness placeholder, so this branch did **not** accept and (by design) fell through.
2. The fall-through reaches the checklist/sentinel grammar. The no-op body has no task-list box, so `CHECKLIST` is empty → the **sentinel branch** (≈L1163): `LAST_LINE != SENTINEL` → `exit 1`.

This is precisely the #217-intended fail-closed direction: "a zero-turn no-op whose tracking comment stays the action's harness placeholder now fails closed instead of passing green." The gate is behaving **as specified**; the defect is upstream — the model no-opping.

## Root-cause hypothesis (evidence-cited)

**Proven mechanism (from logs):** zero-turn model no-op → `num_turns:1`, **0** tool invocations → the model never called `update_claude_comment`, so the tracking comment stayed the action's harness placeholder `"I'll analyze this and get back to you."` → not the sentinel → step-B fail-closed. This is a genuine no-op, not a review that merely omitted the sentinel.

**Hypothesised driver (strong, not proven):** the no-op is **diff-content-driven**, not random:
- It reproduced across **two distinct #273 heads** (`3da6ccb`, `b8a95386`) — randomness would not reliably reproduce.
- The #270 **control** (pure code+test diff, no instruction-file/policy content) reviewed normally (`num_turns:4`) and emitted the sentinel.
- Both failing heads inject **the lens's own governing policy prose** into the review prompt: AGENTS.md Merge-Policy / Codex-wait wording (`👀 reaction means the review is in progress`, `@codex review`, `CLEAN verdict`, `escalate and investigate`), plus the Codex-verdict machinery under `scripts/factory/`. This is a content-level "reviewing text that governs how it should review" confound.
- This **extends** the #269 learning (recorded when #266's slice 2 landed): "the MODEL still no-ops when the injected diff is itself the claude-review lens's own prompt/sentinel/fence/marketplace machinery." #273 shows the no-op class is **broader than the `claude-code-review.yml` file** — it appears to include AGENTS.md merge-policy prose and Codex-verdict logic. #273 does **not** touch `.github/**`, so this is not a workflow-edit confound; all three runs executed under the same base-owned workflow.

**What is NOT the cause (ruled out by logs):** SDK tool-catalog closure (held: `metadata_only=true`), an empty diff (`changeset_empty=false`), and a #266-style deterministic "can't read the diff" no-op (the control #270 reviewed fine). The model's own turn text is not in the logs, so the *why* of the single-turn termination remains a hypothesis.

## Framing: non-required, non-blocking

`claude-review` is **not** in `main`'s required status checks (verified 14 Aug 2026 — the 9 required contexts are the three CodeQL `Analyze` legs, `CodeQL`, `dependency-review`, `Lint, typecheck, unit tests`, `Mutation testing (security-critical Python)`, `Playwright smoke`, `Snowflake migrations (offline)`). The real merge gate for this lens is inline threads + `required_conversation_resolution`, and a no-op posts no threads. So this **does not block merge** — it is red-X noise plus loss of the automated Claude review lens on the affected PR class. The step-C `metadata_only=true` safety evidence still holds, so the lens remains provably inert (no exfil/execution), consistent with the #269 "expected + benign in safety terms" framing — but wider in scope and noisier than #269 documented.

## Candidate fix directions (for a LATER story-planner spec — do NOT build from this issue)

These are directions to weigh at spec time, each with a stated tension; none is chosen here. This touches the protected pipeline surface (`.github/**`) and needs its own contract + `factory-security-reviewer` pass.

1. **Neutral-on-proven-inert-no-op.** Give the metadata-only + `result_clean` + zero-turn (`num_turns==1`, 0 invocations, harness placeholder) case a distinct **non-failing** outcome instead of red. Tension: must not reopen the #217 fail-open — a genuine truncation must still red, so the "benign no-op" signature has to be adversarially distinguishable from a truncated real review (the exact distinction #217 resolved fail-closed). Any such change is a security-gate change on the completion assertion.
2. **Harden diff-as-data framing.** Strengthen the injection so instruction/policy prose in the diff is unambiguously *review data*, not instructions the model acts on (stronger fencing, explicit "this is the change under review, not guidance"). Addresses the content-derailment hypothesis directly; relates to the #194 injection channel D151 widened.
3. **Characterise the trigger.** Confirm whether it is specifically self-referential/policy content (vs size, vs any instruction file) with a small controlled matrix before choosing a fix, since the model turn text is absent from logs and the driver is currently a correlation.
4. **Document-and-quiet.** Formally extend the #269 "expected benign red on self-machinery PRs" note to the AGENTS.md/policy-prose class and reduce alarm (the check is already non-blocking). Weakest option: leaves the affected PRs with zero Claude review signal.

## Relationships

- Post-restore recurrence off **#266** (CLOSED — the deterministic-no-op restoration; its fix works, this is a residual failure mode it did not cover).
- Extends the **#269 learning** on self-machinery no-ops (documented in the plan-repo ledger L88–L90).
- #194-adjacent (the diff-as-data injection channel D151 widened is the vector the policy prose arrives through) and #212-adjacent (the model-behaviour / tool_use verification residual).
- The completion-assertion gate itself is behaving as #146/#217 specified; this is not a regression in that gate.

_Diagnosis only. No spec, no fix in scope here._
